priorityList: Use Recklessness and Avatar together as your primary offensive cooldowns.
Use on-use trinkets and offensive Racials (like Berserking) during Recklessness.
Cast Rampage if Enrage is about to expire or you are at 100 or more Rage.
Cast Bladestorm while Enraged, specifically during Recklessness or if Recklessness has more than 30 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Cast Rampage while Recklessness is active.
Cast Execute whenever it is available (during Execute phase or Sudden Death procs).
Cast Bloodthirst to maintain Enrage and generate Rage.
Cast Rampage as your main Rage spender to maintain Enrage.
Cast Rend if the debuff has less than 6 seconds remaining.
Cast Raging Blow if you have charges available and nothing else to press.
Cast Whirlwind as a filler if no other abilities are available.
Use Charge or Heroic Leap to maintain uptime on the target.
